correctness.rationale: For symmetric two-habitat phase generator A_i=[[r_i1-m,m],[m,r_i2-m]] with a single m>0 and positive durations, reconstructed E_i=exp(tau_i a_i)(cosh(tau_i d_i)I+q_i B_i), B_i=[[b_i,m],[m,-b_i]], q_i>0. Since E_i are symmetric positive definite, cyclic trace and reversal show all products of at most three phases have identical trace, and their common determinant fixes the full 2x2 spectrum and Floquet rate. For four phases independently expanded the only order-sensitive trace term and symbolically verified tr(B1 B2 B3 B4)-tr(B1 B3 B2 B4)=4m²(b1-b4)(b2-b3). Thus the sign law follows from positive common scalar and strict monotonicity of the Perron root in trace at fixed positive determinant. Dihedral action on four permutations yields three trace classes, all distinct for four distinct contrasts. For tau_i=m=1, b=(1,-1,2,-2), and r_{i1/2}=+/-b_i-2/5, the displayed exact exponential-trace brackets certify Lambda_1234<0<Lambda_1324. Independently checked the polynomial identity symbolically, and numerical 65-digit evaluation corroborated the strict witness; original standalone verify.py uses rational series/tail certificate inspected but was not trusted as proof without the independent analytic reconstruction.
